introHtml: Custom LED light whistles combine a loud safety signal with a built-in light source, making them indispensable for nighttime events, campus security, and emergency kits. Unlike standard whistles, the integrated LED ensures you are visible in low-light conditions. Decorate the barrel with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a practical giveaway that recipients will keep on their keychain.
